result.summary: Produced one new evidence patch, docs/validation/evidence/buildings-component-validation-2026-09-20/author-bridge-repair.patch (baseSha256 null), as a unified diff touching ONLY godot/scripts/core/save_owner_buildings.gd. It closes the gap Astra's source inspection found: the candidate's _source_ordinal_refusal pinned only Buildings.STATE_BLUEPRINT, while the accepted BUILDINGS-S4-VALIDATE-R01 v1 contract and ADR 0183 require the exact protected Catalog.BUILDING_STATE ordinals BLUEPRINT 0, BUILDING 1, ACTIVE 2, PAUSED 3, DAMAGED 4, DEMOLISHING 5 (the existing 69-case metadata plan already includes a last-ordinal DEMOLISHING-6 counterfactual the candidate would miss). Hunk 1 adds one small typed constant Array[String] SOURCE_STATE_KEYS of the six keys in ordinal order beside the retained SOURCE_STATE_BLUEPRINT pin. Hunk 2 redirects the tail of _source_ordinal_refusal to a new _source_state_refusal(), which is a safe preflight over the compiled immutable dictionary reached through the existing Buildings preload (Buildings.Catalog.BUILDING_STATE): it pins the bridge's own key-array length against SOURCE_STATE_COUNT, then the dictionary size == 6, then per key has(key), typeof(id) == TYPE_INT and value == expected ordinal 0..5, coercing only after the type check; it then returns _tier_two_refusal() so the existing chain and ordering are unchanged. The loop is a bounded six-iteration preflight before any column projection or indexing, with no per-row allocation, no live Buildings/Definitions/Directory construction, no duplicate/resize/serialisation and no float. All refusals use Section.REFUSE_METADATA with the unchanged METADATA_DETAIL_PREFIX literal 'Buildings owner0 metadata:'; the distinct gate-7 prefix 'Buildings owner 0 ' and its spacing are untouched. Everything else is byte-preserved: the 29 projection assignments and ordinals, Columns.new(false) borrowed-image construction, all other source/metadata/sentinel/definition/tier-two/fact-array checks, existing expressions and room-ordinal block (no unrelated room changes). Patch body is 46 lines total (well under the 90 hard bound, near the 40 aim) across two hunks. This is authored diff text only; no tests, docs, full-file rewrite, execution, import or measurement is claimed or implied, and no engine-observed result is asserted.

diff --git a/godot/scripts/core/save_owner_buildings.gd b/godot/scripts/core/save_owner_buildings.gd
--- a/godot/scripts/core/save_owner_buildings.gd
+++ b/godot/scripts/core/save_owner_buildings.gd
@@ -146,3 +146,6 @@
 ## GDD 4.3's protected BuildingState and RoomType ordinals, pinned exactly.
 const SOURCE_STATE_BLUEPRINT: int = 0
+const SOURCE_STATE_KEYS: Array[String] = [
+	"BLUEPRINT", "BUILDING", "ACTIVE", "PAUSED", "DAMAGED", "DEMOLISHING",
+]
 const SOURCE_ROOM_TYPE_DORMITORY: int = 0
@@ -363,10 +366,35 @@ static func _source_ordinal_refusal() -> SaveHeader.Refusal:
 	if not columns_ok:
 		return _refuse(Section.REFUSE_METADATA,
 			"%s the fact-row columns are not x=%d/z=%d of %d and x=%d/z=%d of %d"
 				% [METADATA_DETAIL_PREFIX, SOURCE_B_FOOTPRINT_X, SOURCE_B_FOOTPRINT_Z,
 					SOURCE_B_FIELD_COUNT, SOURCE_F_FLOOR_X, SOURCE_F_FLOOR_Z,
 					SOURCE_F_FIELD_COUNT])
-	return _tier_two_refusal()
+	return _source_state_refusal()
+
+
+static func _source_state_refusal() -> SaveHeader.Refusal:
+	"""Gate 4: ALL SIX protected BuildingState ordinals, from the compiled catalog dictionary.
+
+	The BLUEPRINT pin above stays. Size, key existence and integer type are proven before any
+	id is coerced, so a renumbered or truncated BUILDING_STATE refuses METADATA before gate 5.
+	"""
+	if SOURCE_STATE_KEYS.size() != SOURCE_STATE_COUNT:
+		return _refuse(Section.REFUSE_METADATA, "%s this bridge pins %d state keys, not %d"
+			% [METADATA_DETAIL_PREFIX, SOURCE_STATE_KEYS.size(), SOURCE_STATE_COUNT])
+	if Buildings.Catalog.BUILDING_STATE.size() != SOURCE_STATE_COUNT:
+		return _refuse(Section.REFUSE_METADATA, "%s BUILDING_STATE holds %d states, not %d"
+			% [METADATA_DETAIL_PREFIX, Buildings.Catalog.BUILDING_STATE.size(),
+				SOURCE_STATE_COUNT])
+	for ordinal: int in SOURCE_STATE_COUNT:
+		var key: String = SOURCE_STATE_KEYS[ordinal]
+		if not Buildings.Catalog.BUILDING_STATE.has(key):
+			return _refuse(Section.REFUSE_METADATA, "%s BUILDING_STATE has no '%s' key"
+				% [METADATA_DETAIL_PREFIX, key])
+		var state_id: Variant = Buildings.Catalog.BUILDING_STATE[key]
+		if typeof(state_id) != TYPE_INT or int(state_id) != ordinal:
+			return _refuse(Section.REFUSE_METADATA, "%s '%s' is not integer state ordinal %d"
+				% [METADATA_DETAIL_PREFIX, key, ordinal])
+	return _tier_two_refusal()
 
 
 static func _tier_two_refusal() -> SaveHeader.Refusal:
